nodes.label: Codebase Architecture & Investigation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Mandates a synergistic two-step tool chain for architecture/dependency/execution-flow analysis: Step 1 (Strict Code) use GitNexus MCP tools (impact/trace/context) to map execution paths, method resolutions, code-level dependencies; Step 2 (Rationale & Docs) use the Graphify skill to query markdown docs/PDFs/inline comments for the design rationale behind that flow. Explicitly forbids blindly grepping or reading raw files to understand system architecture: GitNexus answers 'how', Graphify answers 'why'.

nodes.label: Context-Aware Processing (BaseProcessor._build_augmented_requirements)
nodes.rationale: DO NOT BREAK core context loop: interface text is normalised once before the loop; on each Heading, current_heading updates and info_since_heading resets; on each Information block, cleaned text is appended to info_since_heading; on each System Requirement, the augmented requirement is stamped with heading/info_list/interface_list and info_since_heading is reset immediately after (CRITICAL). Rules: never filter artifacts before this loop (kills context); never duplicate this logic in individual processors (use inheritance instead); never remove heading/info_list/interface_list from PromptBuilder templates; _clean_text_for_logging must keep handling str|list|None because the REQIFZ extractor can return text as a list of XML node strings that all downstream code expects as plain strings.

nodes.label: Hybrid Vision Strategy (Critical Architecture)
nodes.rationale: Per-requirement model selection is centralized in ConfigManager.get_model_for_requirement() (src/config.py:487): a requirement that has images uses llama3.2-vision:11b via generate_response_with_vision(); a requirement without images uses llama3.1:8b via generate_completion(). Model selection must never be hardcoded in processors so the hybrid strategy stays centrally tunable in one place (ConfigManager).

nodes.label: Canonical Test-Case Schema
nodes.rationale: The one true schema emitted by the active adaptive template and expected everywhere downstream is: summary_suffix, preconditions, test_steps, expected_result, test_type. TestCaseDeduplicator.DEFAULT_FIELDS_TO_COMPARE=[test_steps, expected_result, preconditions] must never reintroduce the retired action/data schema — doing so made every pair look nearly identical and silently deleted legitimate test cases (2026-07-05 review finding §1.1). stamp_validation_results must run BEFORE dedup so dedup's 'best' keep-strategy reads the validation_passed flag with indices still aligned; validating after dedup misaligns indices.

nodes.label: Excel Formatter 16-Column Schema
nodes.rationale: Excel export requires exactly 16 columns with specific names: column 13 must be 'Feature Group', column 16 must be 'LinkTest' (not 'Tests'). TestCaseFormatter and StreamingTestCaseFormatter must be changed together whenever columns change, otherwise HP-mode Excel export crashes from column count/name mismatches.

nodes.label: REQIF Attribute Mapping
nodes.rationale: REQIFArtifactExtractor maps internal identifiers like _json2reqif_XXX to human-readable names like 'ReqIF.Text' via _build_attribute_definition_mapping(); bypassing or removing this mapping causes requirements to be skipped with 'no text content' errors.

nodes.label: __slots__ Pattern on Core Classes
nodes.rationale: Core classes (generators, deduplicator, clients) declare __slots__ for memory/perf reasons; adding a new instance attribute requires adding it to the slots tuple first, otherwise it raises AttributeError at runtime instead of silently succeeding.

nodes.label: RAFT Fine-Tuning Pipeline (src/training)
nodes.rationale: src/training implements RAFTDataCollector (collects examples during normal runs), RAFTAnnotator (expert annotation support), RAFTDatasetBuilder, ProgressiveRAFTTrainer (curriculum learning), VisionRAFTTrainer, and QualityScorer. Both enable_raft and collect_training_data default to false in config/cli_config.yaml because RAFT collection was previously opt-out and silently wrote unexpected training_data/ files during normal runs.

nodes.label: Mandatory Protocols (from System_Instructions.md)
nodes.rationale: Pre-Flight: before any complex task, search System_Intructions.md for relevant rules, quote them in the plan, and state how compliance will happen. Verification: never mark a task done until file paths, naming conventions, and formatting are checked against established patterns. Chain-of-Verification: answer, generate verification questions, answer them, revise the original answer. Review Reports always saved to docs/reviews/Review_Comments_YYYY_MM_DD.md. Docstrings follow the Google Python Style Guide.

nodes.label: XHTML Test Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: All artifact text fields use XHTML format, so tests must build artifacts with tests/helpers/ functions (create_test_heading, create_test_requirement) rather than plain dict literals like {'type':'Heading','text':'Door System'}, and assertions must use substring checks (e.g. 'Door System' in artifact['heading']) since headings are XHTML-wrapped, not exact string matches.

nodes.label: Common Pitfalls (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: Symptom->cause->fix table: 'no text content' comes from bypassed attribute mapping (check _build_attribute_definition_mapping); Excel export crash in HP mode comes from wrong column count/name (verify 16 cols, 'LinkTest' not 'Tests'); vision model OOM from too much concurrency (lower --max-concurrent or disable vision); XHTML test mismatches from not using tests/helpers/; generate_test_cases AttributeError from using the wrong generator class (AsyncTestCaseGenerator has that method); TypeError expected str in validators on test_steps because the AI sometimes returns a list, fixed by validators.py joining with newline (do not change this pattern); unexpected training_data/ files come from RAFT collection previously being opt-out (now both enable_raft and collect_training_data default false).

nodes.label: Files Not to Modify Without Full Understanding
nodes.rationale: Enumerates the highest-risk symbols in the codebase (base_processor._build_augmented_requirements, extractors._build_attribute_definition_mapping/_extract_spec_object, formatters header list/StreamingTestCaseFormatter, ollama_client.generate_response_with_vision/AsyncOllamaClient semaphore, generators.extract_image_paths/stamp_validation_results/_postprocess_test_cases, deduplicator.DEFAULT_FIELDS_TO_COMPARE, image_extractor._validate_image/_preprocess_image/cleanup_extracted_images, config.enable_vision/get_model_for_requirement, yaml_prompt_manager.load_all_prompts/_selection_rules) with the reason each is critical. Line numbers drift; the symbol name is authoritative.

nodes.label: Test Layout & Markers
nodes.rationale: Tests live in tests/core (unit), tests/integration, tests/training, tests/unit, tests/performance, plus intentional root-level files (test_critical_improvements.py, test_integration_refactored.py, test_python314_ollama0125.py, test_refactoring.py) that must not be moved or duplicated into subdirectories. Markers: unit, integration, slow, async_test.
